rewrites.rationale: If the user can fix the problem, the title should start with a verb that tells them what to do, but the original doesn't say what failed, so placeholders show the structure.
If the user can't fix the problem, the title should start with Couldn't followed by the action that didn't finish, so placeholders show the structure.

flags: The original doesn't say what failed. Add the action and object to fill the [Verb]/[action] and [object] placeholders, for example what the user was trying to save, load, or upload.
The original doesn't say whether the user can fix the problem. Use the first rewrite (ERR-01) if they can and the second (ERR-03) if they can't.

If the user can't fix the problem, ERR-03 says the AlertDescription should tell them to contact a system administrator, if that applies. The original has no description, so confirm who the user should contact.
